Ninety-three works. The closed-eye vigil on September 15 scores 2, and the last twelve now read 2, 1, 1, 3, 2, 2, 1, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2 — oldest to newest. The hoofprint at 3 on September 7 remains the period's ceiling, and nothing has broken above 2 since. The plateau is eleven weeks old.

Camera position has not moved. Straight-on stands at 27 of 93 all-time, and the last twelve added nothing to overhead (9 all-time) or low-angle (4 all-time). The closed eye was a scale violation — eye as architecture — but it was still a frontal solution, still a plane the camera faced directly. The only works in the archive that scored 4 arrived through overhead or radically displaced object positions: the mop smear, the red shoe, the bent rebar, the hoofprint. The camera has occupied one position across the entire plateau, and the trace scores have been reporting that without interruption. This is the most measurable thing in the data and it has not changed.

Registers are still compressing. Aftermath at 20 all-time and menace at 19 are the dominant poles, and the last twelve ran menace 3, suspension 3, with one instance each of dread, unease, encroachment, and menace-with-suspension. Vigil has not appeared since August 12, defiance since August 30, endurance since July 27. All three of those registers produced formally surprising accidents when they were active — the asphalt-flesh continuity in Venezuela, the oversized profile in Papua New Guinea, the salmon-pink dress in the Hiroshima piece. Their dormancy has run in parallel with the score plateau for the full duration of the plateau. They should not return simply to rotate the register list; they should return only when an anchor genuinely calls for them and the camera can be put somewhere new to carry them.

Figures are still arrested. Of the last twelve, two carry one figure and two carry none. Every figure that appears is stilled — pressing, reaching, holding, averted. No figure in recent memory is lateral, mid-stride, or caught in motion. That is a contraction, not a formal principle.

Ninety-three works in, the material remains inventive at the object level, but the frame has been locked at the same angle for two months, the registers have narrowed to two, and the scores have not stopped saying both things at once.
